summary.zh: 烤前冷藏 · 每份 50–60 g · 350°F 约 19 分钟
summary.en: Chill before baking · 50–60 g each · about 19 minutes at 350°F

name.zh: 巧克力、坚果、葡萄干等配料（合计）
name.en: Chocolate, nuts, raisins, or other mix-ins (total)

steps.zh: 黄油与白糖、红糖打发至蓬松发白。鸡蛋分批加入。
steps.en: Cream the butter with the white and brown sugars until pale and fluffy. Add the eggs in batches.

steps.zh: 粉类过筛后拌入，再加入合计 300 g 的自选配料。
steps.en: Sift and mix in the dry ingredients, then add 300 g total of mix-ins of your choice.

steps.zh: 手写记录每份 50–60 g，烤前冷藏约 1 小时。
steps.en: The handwritten record specifies 50–60 g per portion and chilling for about 1 hour before baking.

steps.zh: 烤箱预热，350°F 烤约 19 分钟，最后根据上色情况调整时间。
steps.en: Preheat the oven and bake at 350°F for about 19 minutes, adjusting the time at the end according to browning.

notes.zh: 白糖用 30–50 g，配料较甜时少放一些。个人口感记录「糖越多越软」。
notes.en: Use 30–50 g white sugar, using less when the mix-ins are sweet. Personal tasting note: “The more sugar, the softer the cookie.”

notes.zh: 巧克力、坚果、葡萄干等配料可自由组合，合计 300 g。可使用白巧克力或夏威夷果，并按配料甜度调整白糖用量。抹茶版沿用基础面团，另加 10 g 抹茶粉，配料同样合计 300 g。
notes.en: Combine chocolate, nuts, raisins, and other mix-ins as desired, totaling 300 g. White chocolate or macadamia nuts may be used; adjust the white sugar to suit the sweetness of the mix-ins. For a matcha version, use the base dough and add 10 g matcha powder; the mix-ins still total 300 g.
